build_gtn_python_package: build the gtn python package with cmake for automatic differentiation with WFSTs
build_gtn_cmake_extension: build a cmake extension module like gtn._graph or gtn._autograd using CMakeBuild
review_CMakeBuild_run: review the CMakeBuild run method that validates cmake version and builds all extensions
review_CMakeBuild_build_extension: review the CMakeBuild build_extension method that configures and builds a single cmake extension
